usedFor: Asyntai AI Chatbot chats with visitors, and Freshsales Classic holds the deals “Update Deal” changes after “New Lead Captured”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Captured” in Asyntai, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A lead captured in chat can move its deal along, changing stage, amount or contacts without retyping.

watchOut: “Update Deal” finds a deal by ID or name, so a matching deal must exist before the lead arrives.
